elements.content: Grammar focus: Legal Syntax Mechanics & Archaic Adverbs.

Core Rule: Use compound pronominal adverbs formed from here / there / where + preposition ( herein = in this document; thereof = of that; statutory = pursuant to ).

Herein / Hereof — In this document / Of this document: The terms specified herein shall take effect immediately.
Thereof / Therein — Of that / In that matter: The board reviewed the contract and all amendments thereof .
Notwithstanding — In spite of / Despite: Notwithstanding any prior agreement, this covenant remains binding.
Hereinafter — In the rest of this document: Acme Corp, hereinafter referred to as 'the Licensee'.
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which sentence correctly applies archaic legal adverbs?
options: The obligations set forth herein shall remain binding upon all signatories.
The obligations set forth in herein shall remain binding.
